purpose: A source profile is the exact authority release artifact grammar recipe witness and completion declaration needed to admit one digital source boundary into Laplace world state; it is not importer configuration or a database mapping and is not a claim that the source is true.

profile_identity.evolution: a changed artifact grammar recipe interpretation denominator or completion law creates a new append-only profile coordinate and fingerprint

generic_execution_law.provider_boundary: thin artifact grammar codec transport and persistence providers expose typed mechanism through common interfaces and cannot own identity AST evidence cognition realization completion or receipt meaning
generic_execution_law.recipe_boundary: all source-varying behavior is declared as typed data and compiled through the common recipe compiler and ISA rather than a source-named semantic dispatcher or opaque callback
generic_execution_law.working_set: the whole-working-set planner may combine compatible operations from several profiles so shared subtrees references mappings and dependence are resolved once over the selected boundary
generic_execution_law.reuse: registry validation planning batching presence deposition receipt and lifecycle code is shared; a profile contributes declarations grammar bindings conformance vectors and only truly source-specific kernels
generic_execution_law.unsupported: absence of a valid profile grammar recipe or declared disposition is an explicit unsupported result and never an invitation to guess

selected_boundary.manifest: a separately receipted run manifest names the exact ordered profile fingerprints artifact fingerprints recipe and grammar epochs and intended witness boundary
selected_boundary.closure: the selected boundary closes only when every profile denominator and cross-profile endpoint reconciles and every required derived publication is coherent
selected_boundary.nonexemplar: one completed profile family grammar modality or domain proves only its declared boundary
